messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: PAGER FIRED -> inference-gateway (us-west1) | metric: http_5xx_rate > 12% over 5m | severity: P1 | link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-12345

pagerduty: routed to #incidents and paging jordan (oncall)

jordan (oncall): acked via PD. I'm on it :white_check_mark:

jordan (oncall): quick check - is this across regions or localized to us-west1? any customer support tickets?

sam (eng-sre): seeing the spike only in us-west1 ingress. 502/504 mix. No high-priority customer tickets yet, but increased latencies in metrics.

lee (platform): stack traces point at kvcache backend timeouts + upstream model-serving 503s. correlates with a canary that started ~12:34 UTC.

jordan (oncall): runbook step 1: check autoscaler and kvcache evictions. I'm running the quick commands now.

sam (eng-sre): logs (truncated):
```
ingress: 2026-03-17T12:39:02Z level=error status=502 upstream=10.1.5.23: read timeout
model-proxy: 2026-03-17T12:39:03Z warn kv_cache: eviction spike (rate=240/s)
```

lee (platform): kvcache eviction TTL jumped after canary added larger context objects. Likely memory pressure + bursty requests.

jordan (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) pause canary 2) increase cache capacity on us-west1 3) reroute traffic to eu-west1 where healthy 4) scale up dedicated pool if needed. I'll start with pausing canary.

sam (eng-sre): pausing canary now -> `kubectl patch deployment canary-deploy -n inference -p '{"spec":{"replicas":0}}'`

ops-manager: heads-up to SRE oncall rotation, may need a short capacity commit if scale needed.

incident-bot: automatic escalation check: unacked threshold cleared (jordan acked). Monitoring for 10m before closing escalation.

lee (platform): canary pods terminated, starting gradual cache warmup and bumping kvcache size by +30% on us-west1 (config change).

sam (eng-sre): routing adjustment applied: 15% of traffic moved to eu-west1 for model-backend via traffic-slice policy.

jordan (oncall): markers: error-rate dropped from 18% -> 6% over last 3m after rollback + routing. Customer impact: degraded responses for ~10-15% of requests in us-west1 during spike window, some retries observed. No major data loss.

ops-manager: please prepare brief incident note for customers if we see any support escalations.

sam (eng-sre): keeping watch on KV eviction metrics and model-proxy 5xx tails. Setting short-term alert to 10% to catch regressions.

jordan (oncall): handing off to night oncall sam in 25m. Sam, will you take post-mitigation watch and confirm stable? @sam (eng-sre)

sam (eng-sre): I have it. I'll keep 1hr watch and escalate if >8% 5xx persists.

jordan (oncall): adding runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx-response. Filed initial incident notes.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident acknowledged by jordan (oncall); escalation suspended.

jordan (oncall): closing PD when metrics stable for 20m. For now status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will update if anything changes. :eyes:
